migration_summary: Setting an existing column NOT NULL without first backfilling null rows; integrity scan fails mid-upgrade when legacy nulls remain.
migration_sql: ALTER TABLE task_instance ALTER COLUMN pool_slots SET NOT NULL;
schema_summary: task_instance with historical rows where pool_slots may be NULL from Airflow 1.x eras.

risk_flags.message: ALTER ... SET NOT NULL validates existing rows and fails if nulls remain.

risk_narrative: Migration 0080 changed pool_slots to NOT NULL with a server default, but a prior PR removed the UPDATE that filled nulls. Upgrades from older Airflow hit NotNullViolation: column pool_slots contains null values and the deploy stopped mid-migration.
lessons_learned: Before enforcing NOT NULL on a populated table, UPDATE nulls (or delete) first, ideally in a prior expand step. Server defaults do not rewrite existing nulls on PostgreSQL for SET NOT NULL. Pair constraint validation with a measured backfill.
surprise_notes: Adding a default is not enough—existing NULL rows still fail the NOT NULL scan. Rollback required a fixed migration that replaced nulls before the constraint.

documented_outcomes.error_message: psycopg2.errors.NotNullViolation: column "pool_slots" contains null values (Airflow issue #24566).

prediction_summary.risk_explanation: Constraint validation is a full-table scan whose failure mode is hard abort, not slow success.

dimension_details.downgrade_pair: Airflow migrations have explicit downgrade paths for rollback planning.
